title: The Endowment Model and Modern Portfolio Theory
eligible_reason: Theory paper: a dynamic portfolio-choice model with illiquid alternative assets, solved numerically in MATLAB (folders comparei, comparepsi, comparegamma, comparethetaL, comparealpha, compareepsilon_*, compareinflow, spendingconstraint, financialcisis produce Figures 1-5 and Tables 3-9 as model solutions). The only Stata file (Stata/Create_Tables_1_D1_D2_Code.do) assembles the 2015 NACUBO-Commonfund Endowment Survey cross-section and computes summary statistics (summ, tabstat) for Table 1 and Appendix Tables D1-D2. No regression of any kind is estimated (regression extractor found zero commands). The 'staggered' flag refers to 'staggered lockup expirations' of alternative assets in the model, not to a staggered-adoption design.
design_notes: No empirical treatment-effect design. Calibration inputs: 2015 NCES survey (812 endowments, aggregated to university level via a hand-built CFID-UNITID map), betas and horizons from the literature, covariances from indexes.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Not applicable; no treatment variable exists.
data_files_note: No survey data shipped: README and the do-file state the NACUBO-Commonfund data agreement does not permit sharing. The package ships MATLAB .mat files holding model solutions (e.g., comparei/datai1.mat, financialcisis/datasimulation.mat), not empirical data.
software_note: MATLAB for the model (numerical solutions and figures); one Stata do-file for summary statistics.
screener_notes: Theory/calibration paper with a single cross-sectional summary-statistics table. No DiD, no regression. Exclude.
